title: Edit > Copy Motion / Paste Motion for motion tweens
description: Flash 8 had Edit > Copy Motion (copies tween settings from selected object) and Edit > Paste Motion (applies those settings to a different object). Useful for reusing animation. Implement clipboard-based motion tween copy/paste: Copy Motion stores the selected keyframe's tween parameters (type, ease, duration, easeX/easeY curves) in a motion clipboard; Paste Motion applies those parameters to the selected object's keyframe. Add to Edit menu and wire in Shell.tsx.
